thought.text: The project's `backend/.cargo/config.toml` requires `clang` + `lld`. This is a hard requirement of the build. Let me install clang and lld.

reasoning_content:
The project pins `linker=clang` and `link-arg=-fuse-ld=lld` in `backend/.cargo/config.toml`. This is intentional — the project uses clang + lld. So I need to install clang and lld. Let me install them.

This is a documented requirement in the sense that the project config requires it, though not explicitly in the guide's Requirements list. Let me install clang and lld.

action.command: DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y clang lld 2>&1 | tail -3; echo "=== versions ==="; clang --version | head -1; lld --version 2>&1 | head -1

tool_call.name: terminal
